pane.keepRunning.zh: 请保持ChemDraw Add-in for Mac运行。点击菜单栏图标打开设置。
pane.keepRunning.en: Keep ChemDraw Add-in for Mac running. Use its menu bar icon to open settings.

pane.officeNote.zh: 请在Word或PowerPoint中打开此面板，以编辑所选绘图。
pane.officeNote.en: Open this panel inside Word or PowerPoint to edit a selection.

pane.step2.zh: 按⌘V、右键选择“粘贴”，或点击此面板中的“粘贴可编辑绘图”。新建且尚未保存的文档也可使用。Office文档由你按需要保存。
pane.step2.en: Paste with ⌘V, right-click → Paste, or Paste editable drawing in this panel, including a new unsaved document. Save your Office document whenever you choose.

pane.step3.zh: 双击绘图即可编辑，ChemDraw未运行时也可打开。
pane.step3.en: Double-click the drawing to edit, even when ChemDraw is closed.

pane.step4.zh: 在ChemDraw中保存，即可更新Office中的图片并继续编辑。关闭ChemDraw文档后可返回原文档。
pane.step4.en: Save in ChemDraw to update Office while editing. Close the ChemDraw document to return to your original document.

pane.setupHelp.zh: 从“应用程序”或菜单栏图标打开ChemDraw Add-in for Mac。选择“设置加载项”，查看授权并自动配置本地编辑助手。
pane.setupHelp.en: Open ChemDraw Add-in for Mac from Applications or its menu bar icon. Choose “Add-in Setup” to view permissions and automatically configure the local editing helper.

pane.activationHelp.zh: 在“开始 → 加载项 → 开发人员加载项 → ChemDraw Add-in for Mac”中激活。激活后也可从ChemDraw Add-in for Mac功能区选项卡打开。
pane.activationHelp.en: Find the entry under Home → Add-ins → Developer Add-ins → ChemDraw Add-in for Mac. Once activated, the ChemDraw Add-in for Mac ribbon tab also opens it.

pane.officeHelp.zh: 使用已安装的Office。在每个应用中点击蓝色C图标以激活面板。若自动检查显示入口被禁用，请在Office前台实际点击确认。
pane.officeHelp.en: Use your existing Office installation. Open the blue C entry inside each app to activate the panel. If an automated check labels the entry disabled, confirm it with an actual foreground click.

pane.repairHelp.zh: 若面板无法加载，请打开设置窗口并选择“修复加载项”。首次安装时还需按提示信任本地连接证书。
pane.repairHelp.en: If the panel will not load, open the configuration window and choose “Repair Add-in”. A fresh installation also needs the Mac to trust the local localhost certificate.

pane.previewHelp.zh: 本地预览自动选择已安装的最新ChemDraw，并使用Office桌面应用。生成的SVG绘图包含完整的可编辑源数据。
pane.previewHelp.en: This local preview automatically selects the newest installed ChemDraw and needs the desktop Office applications. It creates managed SVG drawings with full editable source.

pane.editHint.zh: 在ChemDraw中保存以更新Office；关闭ChemDraw文档后可返回原文档。
pane.editHint.en: Save in ChemDraw to update Office; close the ChemDraw document to return to your original document.

pane.draftHint.zh: 双击原绘图继续编辑，或粘贴新的结构。
pane.draftHint.en: Double-click the original drawing to resume, or paste a new structure.

pane.pasteHint.zh: 按⌘V、右键选择“粘贴”，或点击“粘贴可编辑绘图”。
pane.pasteHint.en: Paste with ⌘V, right-click → Paste, or use Paste editable drawing.

pane.setupHint.zh: 打开ChemDraw Add-in for Mac →“设置加载项”，完成授权并启动粘贴助手。
pane.setupHint.en: Open ChemDraw Add-in for Mac → “Add-in Setup” to finish permissions and start the paste helper.

pane.opening.en: Opening the selected drawing in ChemDraw…

pane.failed.en: The drawing action could not be completed.

pane.opened.zh: 绘图已在ChemDraw中打开。保存以更新Office；关闭ChemDraw文档后可返回原文档。
pane.opened.en: Your drawing is open in ChemDraw. Save to update Office; close the ChemDraw document to return to your original document.

manifest.description.zh: 使用已安装的ChemDraw编辑带有源数据的矢量化学结构。
manifest.description.en: Edit source-carrying vector chemistry with your installed ChemDraw.

manifest.help.zh: 打开ChemDraw Add-in for Mac面板，编辑所选绘图、检查连接状态及查看使用说明。
manifest.help.en: Open the ChemDraw Add-in for Mac panel to edit the selected drawing, check connection status, and view instructions.

system.automation.zh: ChemDraw Add-in for Mac控制ChemDraw、Word和PowerPoint，在本机编辑化学结构并回写到文档。
system.automation.en: ChemDraw Add-in for Mac controls ChemDraw, Word and PowerPoint to edit chemical drawings locally and write them back to your document.

installer.welcome.1.zh: 版本1.3.4 · Apple Silicon + Intel · macOS 12或更新
installer.welcome.1.en: Version 1.3.4 · Apple Silicon + Intel · macOS 12 or later

installer.welcome.2.zh: 界面根据系统首选语言显示中文或英文，覆盖应用窗口、Office面板、功能区及安装提示。
installer.welcome.2.en: The app windows, Office panel, ribbon, and installation instructions follow your preferred system language in Chinese or English.

installer.welcome.3.zh: 更改系统首选语言后，请从菜单栏退出应用，再重新打开应用和Office以切换界面语言。
installer.welcome.3.en: After changing your preferred system language, quit the app from its menu bar, then reopen the app and Office to switch the interface language.

installer.welcome.4.zh: 安装后自动打开“设置加载项”，按系统提示允许Office文件访问，完成四项检查后即可使用。
installer.welcome.4.en: Add-in Setup opens automatically after installation. Allow Office file access when prompted, then complete the four checks to start using the app.

installer.welcome.5.zh: 已有绘图、连接证书及恢复草稿继续保留。从旧版升级时，按系统提示确认辅助功能和自动化授权。
installer.welcome.5.en: Existing drawings, connection certificates, and recovery drafts are retained. When upgrading from an older version, confirm Accessibility and Automation access when prompted.

installer.welcome.6.zh: 升级前请完成当前编辑并退出应用。
installer.welcome.6.en: Finish editing and quit the app before upgrading.

installer.conclusion.0.zh: 完成ChemDraw Add-in for Mac安装
installer.conclusion.0.en: ChemDraw Add-in for Mac Installation Complete

installer.conclusion.1.zh: 应用将自动打开“设置加载项”，分别检查Word文件访问、PowerPoint文件访问、辅助功能和粘贴助手。
installer.conclusion.1.en: The app will open Add-in Setup automatically to check Word file access, PowerPoint file access, Accessibility, and the paste helper.

installer.conclusion.2.zh: 请在系统提示中允许访问所用的Word／PowerPoint。程序会自动验证目录读写并启动助手，四项检查通过后点击“完成”。
installer.conclusion.2.en: Allow access to the Word and PowerPoint apps you use when prompted. The app will verify directory access and start the helper automatically. Click “Done” when all four checks pass.

installer.conclusion.3.zh: 从旧版升级时，按系统提示确认辅助功能和自动化授权。
installer.conclusion.3.en: When upgrading from an older version, confirm Accessibility and Automation access when prompted.

installer.conclusion.4.zh: 文件访问被拒绝时，点击“重新授权文件访问”或主界面的“修复加载项”，按提示允许后程序会自动继续。
installer.conclusion.4.en: If file access is denied, click “Authorize File Access Again” or “Repair Add-in” in the main window. Allow access when prompted; setup will continue automatically.

installer.conclusion.5.zh: 后续点击“检查更新”即可在应用内下载并安装新版本，安装结束后自动重新打开。
installer.conclusion.5.en: Use “Check for Updates” to download and install new versions in the app. The app will reopen automatically after installation.

installer.conclusion.6.zh: 在ChemDraw中复制结构，到Word或PowerPoint粘贴；双击继续编辑，保存即可更新Office图片，关闭ChemDraw文档后可返回原文档。
installer.conclusion.6.en: Copy a structure in ChemDraw and paste it into Word or PowerPoint. Double-click to edit, save to update the Office image, and close the ChemDraw document to return to your original document.
